$comment: Contract for data/tables/profiles.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Print setup
description: One row per published print profile for an exact grade. Its qualitative notes are rows of profile_notes.csv, one per topic (D69).

fields.name: ProfileID
fields.description: Stable profile identifier.

fields.name: MaterialID
fields.description: Material the profile belongs to.

fields.name: GradeID
fields.description: Exact grade the profile is published for.

fields.name: Profile
fields.description: Kind of guidance.

fields.name: Nozzle °C
fields.description: Nozzle °C as published; parsed by the build.

fields.name: Nozzle state
fields.description: Reviewed reading of Nozzle °C: range, not-required, ambient, no-setpoint, recommended or unknown.

fields.name: Nozzle min °C
fields.description: Lower end of the window; Not published for an up-to value; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Nozzle max °C
fields.description: Upper end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Nozzle requirement
fields.description: required, recommended, none or unknown.

fields.name: Bed °C

fields.name: Bed max °C
fields.description: Upper end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Bed requirement
fields.description: required, recommended, none or unknown.
